name: Orgasm Treatment
source:
Mother's Treatment takes you on a thrilling and sensual journey of recovery after a life-threatening car accident leaves the protagonist with memory loss and in a coma. But there’s something extraordinary about his body’s response to intimate touch—it seems to help him heal.

When a nurse, unable to resist his irresistible body, discovers that his condition improves with sexual release, she takes matters into her own hands, kickstarting his recovery in the most unexpected way. As he starts to regain strength, his mother—who he hasn’t seen in years—steps into the picture, desperate to help him. Catching him in the middle of a steamy encounter with the nurse, she realizes that she might be the key to his full recovery. Soon, she’s doing everything she can to make sure he gets back to full health.

With a mix of supernatural healing, intimate tension, and forbidden desire, Mother's Treatment explores the boundaries of passion and family ties in a steamy, unforgettable story.

[From [url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/mothers-treatment]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《母亲的治疗》将带你踏上一场惊心动魄、感性的康复之旅，主角在一场危及生命的车祸中失忆并陷入昏迷。但他的身体对亲密触摸的反应有些非同寻常——这似乎有助于他康复。

当一名护士无法抵抗他不可抗拒的身体，发现他的病情随着性的释放而改善时，她把事情掌握在自己手中，以最意想不到的方式启动了他的康复。当他开始恢复体力时，他多年未见的母亲出现了，迫切地想要帮助他。当他与护士发生热辣的邂逅时，她意识到自己可能是他完全康复的关键。很快，她正在尽一切努力确保他完全恢复健康。

《母亲的治疗》融合了超自然的治愈、亲密的紧张和禁忌的欲望，在一个热气腾腾、令人难忘的故事中探索了激情和家庭关系的界限。
